title: White Elephant Gifts People Actually Fight Over
label: White Elephant
intro: A great white elephant gift gets stolen three times. The trick is something everyone secretly wants but would never buy: a mini waffle maker, a massage gun, a tiny projector, a karaoke mic. Wrap it in pink paper so the whole room knows which one to steal.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on wood floorboards of a pink mini waffle maker, mini massage gun, portable projector, milk frother, karaoke mic, candle warmer lamp and pink and gold wrapping paper.
Chin-down crop of a woman in a cream fair isle sweater hugging a pink and gold wrapped gift inside a red barn lit with string lights for a white elephant party.

items.name: Portable mini projector
items.note: Home projectors were one of last season's most searched gifts.
